units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:6">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>סיפלני דמ׳ עמר</he> a compress of wool lint; <he>דמ׳ דכיתן</he> of linen lint.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:3:4">Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אילו מאן דנסב מ׳ וכ׳</he> if one takes a tuft of wool and puts it on his head in cold weather.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:1:5">Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:6:5">Y. Taan. I, 64ᶜ</cite> <he>תרי מ׳</he> soaked a tuft.

senses.gloss: a garment made of (plucked) wool (v. P. Sm. 2224; Arab. mirṭ species indumenti ex lana &c.), a coarse garment.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:20">Targ. Prov. XXV, 20</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 1:2:8">Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עד כדון … תליין ביה מַרְטוּטֵיכוֹן</he> (not … <he>טכין</he>) R. S. is still alive, and you hang your garments on him, i.e. you refer to him as your authority!
